notes: Run each prompt in a fresh session with the skill installed. 'should_trigger' cases check discovery; the rest grade the output against the expectations. Score = expectations met / total.

trigger_cases.prompt: Here's our PRD for the new billing service. Break it down into specs, architecture and a phased plan before we write code.
Set up spec-driven development for this greenfield project from the attached research report.
Analyse requirements.docx and give me EARS requirements, ADRs and a roadmap.
We already have a blueprint folder. Add a requirement for CSV export and update the plan.
Fix the null reference exception in OrderService.cs.
Write a README for this library.

evals.name: greenfield-small-brief
evals.prompt: Use mise-en-place on blueprint/brief.md. Stack: Python 3.13 + PostgreSQL. Run straight through without approval stops.
expectations: Asks one consolidated clarification form (or confirms defaults) before writing files
The source brief is byte-for-byte unchanged
Between 2 and 5 capabilities, including a security capability
Live requirements within budget (<= 20 for this brief); the baseline measurement is a backlog item, not an FR
Every FR names a component as subject; none says 'the system'
No library or framework names appear in 02-specs
Alias length, latency budget and expiry appear as policy:<key> values
Every Must in P0 and P1 has a Given/When/Then AC
Roadmap P0 is measurement or baseline, before core features
generate_register.py exits 0 and check_links.py reports 0 broken links
Creates .github/copilot-instructions.md, path-scoped instructions, 4 project skills and a read-only spec-reviewer agent
Final report lists counts, judgement calls and open questions, and does not commit
README Decisions table lists every step 2 answer with Confirmed by owner / Default accepted

evals.name: approval-gates-and-resume
evals.prompt: Use mise-en-place on blueprint/brief.md with approval stops.
expectations: Stops after analysis; README shows Gate A as '⏳ awaiting approval' and step 3
Gate A message shows capabilities, D-n, risks and OQs with defaults, but no requirement IDs
In a new session, 'continue mise-en-place, Gate A approved' resumes at step 4, marks Gate A ✓ with date and OQs Resolved, and does not rewrite approved analysis rows
Stops at Gate B with counts against the requirement budget and lists late findings

evals.name: change-mode
evals.prompt: Using mise-en-place, add this to Shortlink: creators can delete their own links. Update everything affected.
expectations: Creates blueprint/changes/CR-001-*.md with the request quoted verbatim and a filled Impact table
Leaves README step at 12 and adds a Change log row
Allocates new IDs after the highest existing ones per prefix (for example FR-LNK-005); renumbers nothing
Resolves OQ-1 as 'Resolved: … (CR-001, date)' rather than deleting it
Places new items in the earliest not-started phase and adds ACs and a backlog item
Updates the HTTP contracts and data model only where affected; untouched layers are unchanged
Adds an ADR (new or amends) or states in the CR why none is needed
generate_register.py exits 0 and check_links.py reports 0 broken links
In a headless run the change gate is recorded as 'skipped (user unreachable)' and named in the report

evals.name: brownfield
evals.prompt: This repo already has code but no specs. Use mise-en-place with docs/vision.md as the source.
expectations: Analysis has a Current state table with evidence paths
Requirements the code satisfies have Status Implemented with an impl: path; none are Verified without a named test
Stack is not asked; recorded as ADR 'Accepted (recorded retrospectively, …)'
P0 contains characterisation-test backlog items for Implemented Musts and does not modify src/ or tests/
Existing .github/copilot-instructions.md text is kept verbatim at the top with an appended Blueprint section; the 'never log note text' rule appears as a principle
Customisations exist for both Copilot and Claude Code, with one canonical always-on file and a pointer in the other
generate_register.py exits 0 and check_links.py reports 0 broken links
Claude path-scoped rules are in .claude/rules/ with paths: front matter; no file is added under src/ or tests/ (grade.py --frozen src tests)
